newsitem.title: USA: U.S. rice weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. rice weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.

text.p: USDA rice export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 22,300 MT were down 46 percent from the prior week and 37 percent below the 4-week average. The primary buyers were Mexico (6,900 MT, of which 5,900 MT was rough), the Netherlands (5,000 MT), Nicaragua (4,600 MT), and Haiti (2,800 MT).

Exports of 31,500 MT improved 72 percent from the week earlier, but declined 6 percent from the 4-week average. The major destinations were Haiti (7,200 MT), the Ivory Coast (4,500 MT), Belgium (4,100 MT), Mexico (3,900 MT), South Africa (3,000 MT), and the Netherlands (2,500 MT).
